title: The defaults that kill a carousel

slides.headline: Templated is a *defaults* problem.
slides.deck: The tool is not the issue. Nobody ever told it what to stop doing.

slides.headline: Every generator ships the *same* taste.
slides.body: Rotate the palette, swap the font, and the layout underneath has not moved. Readers clock it by the third post because the structure never changes.

rows.title: One layout, many colours
rows.body: variety that is only skin deep

rows.title: No rule about what to avoid
rows.body: so the defaults win every time

slides.headline: Fix the *layout* first.
slides.deck: Each of these is a rule that removes one specific bad habit.

items.name: fill-the-frame
items.body: Grows type until content reaches the fill target.
items.kills: The slide that is two thirds empty paper.

items.name: one-loud-thing
items.body: Accent touches exactly one span per slide.
items.kills: Three highlighted phrases and no emphasis.

items.name: hairline-rows
items.body: Rules instead of a white card per row.
items.kills: The stack of cards that screams generated.

items.name: safe-band
items.body: Keeps content out of the top and bottom 135px.
items.kills: Headlines sliced off in the profile grid.

items.name: decor-loses
items.body: Drops the illustration when copy needs the room.
items.kills: Half a mascot behind a terminal window.

slides.headline: Then fix the *copy*.
slides.deck: Budgets are layout constraints, not style preferences.

items.name: char-budgets
items.body: Errors when a headline cannot fit at any size.
items.kills: Type shrunk to 43% to hide a long line.

items.name: second-hook
items.body: Slide 2 must stand alone, not continue slide 1.
items.kills: A deck re-served from a slide that makes no sense.

items.name: no-hype
items.body: Plain declaratives. Headlines end with a period.

items.name: concede-once
items.body: Warns when your side wins every comparison.
items.kills: The roundup that reads as an advert.

items.name: real-numbers
items.body: Figures come from the source or get cut.
items.kills: A confident statistic nobody can check.

slides.headline: Rules found by *breaking* things.

stats.label: Themes, each with its own rules

slides.body: Every one of these started as something that shipped wrong and got caught by looking at the render rather than the log.

slides.quote: A template is only templated when nobody wrote down what to avoid.

slides.headline: The full *rule set*.
slides.body: all ten, what each one kills, and the checker that enforces them.
